body_es: La Definición de Hecho (DoD) es un acuerdo explícito del equipo sobre qué significa que una historia de usuario o tarea esté completada. Incluye criterios técnicos como código revisado, pruebas unitarias completas, pruebas de integración aprobadas, y documentación actualizada, además de criterios funcionales como que la característica cumpla los criterios de aceptación. Una DoD clara y consistente asegura calidad uniforme, reduce sorpresas al final del sprint, y acelera la velocidad del equipo eliminando retrasos por rework o retroalimentación tardía.
body_en: The Definition of Done (DoD) is an explicit team agreement on what it means for a user story or task to be completed. It includes technical criteria such as code reviewed, unit tests complete, integration tests passed, and documentation updated, plus functional criteria such as the feature meeting acceptance criteria. A clear and consistent DoD ensures uniform quality, reduces end-of-sprint surprises, and accelerates team velocity by eliminating delays from rework or late feedback.
example_code:
# Definition of Done (DoD) Checklist
definition_of_done:
  code_quality:
    - "Code peer reviewed and approved (2 reviewers)"
    - "Code merged to main branch"
    - "No warnings in SonarQube analysis"
    - "Code coverage >= 80%"
  
  testing:
    - "Unit tests written and passing"
    - "Integration tests passing"
    - "Manual QA testing completed"
    - "Bug-free status confirmed"
  
  documentation:
    - "Code comments added for complex logic"
    - "API documentation updated"
    - "User documentation created/updated"
  
  deployment_readiness:
    - "Feature branch squashed and clean"
    - "Ready for production deployment"
    - "Release notes prepared"
    - "No technical debt introduced"
  
  verification:
    - "Product Owner acceptance confirmed"
    - "Acceptance criteria met"
    - "Demo-ready for Sprint Review"
